lines: Hey, is it really true that it's a juicy job? You're not planning something fishy again, are you?
Don't be ridiculous! Why would we lie to you!
It was understandable for Sakura to be suspicious.
As we followed the gangster, we completely left the bustling neighborhoods and came to a dimly lit area with few passersby.
(A lot of assaults and kidnappings happen in this area... This is a hot spot for crime.)
If you're up to something I'll give you another beating.
Please believe me! My big sis still has some work to do and I know that I'm not the best person to lead the way, but...
This guy, his personality is different now...
The man's attitude had completely changed, perhaps from getting a good beating from Sakura.
(By the looks of it, he isn't up to anything fishy... and if he tried anything, Sakura's fists would fly.)
Anyway, what's this work you're talking about? I'm about ready for you to tell us...
Huuuuh!? Why the hell do I have you tell you!? Brat!!
Hey!! Be nice and tell us!
Of course!! Right away!! Ehrm... so the work is...
(What's up with the difference in how he treats me and Sakura...)
It seemed like this guy was still looking down on me since I hadn't participated in the fight at all.
As for details, it's a mercenary job. What you'd call bodyguard work.
Some big shot customer is urgently gathering talented individuals, and my big sis was also asked to help.
A bodyguard? I don't want to do anything bad.
No, no! No need to worry!
If I'm not mistaken, it's about escorting cargo or something like that...
Well, to be honest, I don't know the exact details either.
(Escorting cargo? So they're transporting something that they expect to be attacked...?)
Is what I wanted to ask, but I decided to stay quiet since he was treating me with contempt.
I heard it's definitely going to be dangerous. That's why the compensation is amazing. From what I've heard... lend me your ear for a moment.
What is it, what is it...?
Sakura jumped up, her eyes turning into dollar signs.
We'll do it! We'll definitely do it! Right, Fumachin!?
Of course! Let's both get some pocket money and have a fancy dinner~♪
N-Not a bad idea, I guess...
Oh! We've arrived! It's just over there!!
Faust-san! I've brought someone! Two highly skilled soldiers!!
We had arrived at an abandoned construction site. There were about 20 scary-looking men already gathered.
The one leading them was a female soldier with a bizarre appearance, as if her entire body was mechanized.
Don't judge them by their appearance!! True, they look like stupid kids, but their skills are polished as hell!!
The woman introduced herself with a electronic-sounding voice and turned her machine-covered face toward us.
(Her whole body is mechanized like a cyborg...? She's no ordinary person.)
What?! They're just some green little brats!
Shoo shoo! This isn't playtime for kiddies!
Or do you want us to teach you how to play like adults? Gyahahah!!!!
The gathered men started to jeer at us one after another.
(They're a pretty boorish bunch. But I get why they're looking down on us...)
Mercenary work is easy!! I'll have you know that the almighty and world-renowned Taimaー
I had hurriedly covered Sakura's mouth.

Mgmghghgh!? Nhgngngh~!?
(F-Fumachin!? What are you doing~!?)
(You moron!! What are you doing telling them who we really are! Take a look, all of them are right at home in shady dealings!)
(There might be people from Nomad among them as well. If you say something rash we're in deep shit!!)
I had noticed as soon as we had arrived.
Among the men gathered, there were a few faces that I had seen in documents before.
All of them were well-known figures in underground society, and more than a few of them were suspected to be involved with the criminal organization Nomad.
(Th-That means... if these guys are all villains, then this is a dirty job...?)
(No, I'm not sure about that. They definitely aren't good guys, but it's possible they were just hired.)

Nomad's organizational form was fluid and difficult to grasp, and it couldn't be said as a rule that just because a member of Nomad was participating in something that it was a job for their organization.
(Uhh, so...? What do we do, Fuma-kun?)
(If anything, now my interest is piqued.)
(This job. These guys, trying to find out what they're up to... It could be a fun little activity.)
At Faust's orders, the mercenaries around us began to move.

▪ You're finally gonna let us wreak havoc!
▪ My body's all stiff from standing around.
Okay, I'll have fun with the cute little miss over here.
(Wh-What do we do, Fuma-kun!? Is it really okay for us to accept this part-time job!? Can I show him my real strength!?)
(I guess you can? I'm starting to have fun as well. Go as crazy as you can without giving away that you're a Taimanin.)
Sakura nodded, clenched her fists tightly, and turned towards the mercenaries.
I was hoping you'd test my strength!! I'll show you the power of the mighty Sakura-chan, so bring it on!!
You've got some nerve, huh!!! I don't hate feisty little girls!!!
The Orc mercenary immediately lunged at Sakura.
(Well, in any case... I don't think Sakura should have any issues. She won't lose to mercenaries like those guys.)
I was thinking of pretending to join the fight and not doing much... but then right in front of me stepped a somewhat gloomy-looking female mercenary.
...I'm Tsubaki. Right now, I am acting as a mercenary. I'll be the one to see what you can do.
Ehm, no wait, uh...? I'm basically just here as her chaperone, so be gentle...
Hehe... do you think this would count as a test of skill if I went easy on you?
The female mercenary seemed to be fairly skilled. Even in her casual movements, she didn't have any openings.
(Shit... I can't run away at this point, so I guess I have no choice but to do it!)
If it was just a test of skill, most likely she wouldn't kill me... please don't kill meー
While I wished for that, I reluctantly prepared for battle.
